title: Fitness to Practice for Trainee Psychologists: What No One Tells You

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们不仅靠出卖时间换取金钱，还能赚取更多收入，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名临床心理学家，自2019年以来我一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现在开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己曾在2022年参加过这个项目，此后也一直支持两批心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励以及我提供的专属支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场团体内训大师班、个性化指导、一份福特纳姆与梅森的精美礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过简介中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: Could one badly judged email, one social media post, or one period of struggling at work put your psychology career at risk before it's even begun?
sentences.zh: 一封考虑不周的电子邮件、一条社交媒体帖子或职场上的一段艰难时期，会不会让你的心理学职业生涯在刚开始时就陷入危机？

sentences.en: Most trainees will never face fitness to practice proceedings, but if concerns are raised, the process can feel frightening, confusing, and surprisingly difficult to navigate.
sentences.zh: 大多数实习生永远不会面临胜任能力听证程序，但如果提出了担忧，这个过程会让人感到恐惧、困惑，而且出奇地难以应对。

sentences.en: Today, I'm chatting with legal advisor Nicola Sturkling as we explore what really triggers fitness to practice concerns.
sentences.zh: 今天，我将与法律顾问尼古拉·斯塔克兰一起探讨究竟是什么引发了对胜任能力的担忧。

sentences.en: What happens next and how trainees can protect themselves without feeling terrified of making a mistake.
sentences.zh: 接下来会发生什么，以及实习生如何在不害怕犯错的情况下保护自己。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, and this is Psychology Actually.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，这里是《直击心理学》。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to Psychology Actually.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《直击心理学》。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是玛丽安·特伦特博士，一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: I'm delighted to be welcoming back to the podcast, Nicola Sturkling, who is a legal advisor and the founder of NS Consulting.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴再次邀请尼古拉·斯塔克兰做客本播客，她是NS咨询公司的创始人兼法律顾问。

sentences.en: Hi, Nicola.
sentences.zh: 嗨，尼古拉。

sentences.en: Hi, Marianne.
sentences.zh: 嗨，玛丽安。

sentences.en: It's nice to see you again.
sentences.zh: 很高兴再次见到你。

sentences.en: It's great to be back to discuss some really interesting points.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能回来讨论一些非常有趣的话题。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And I should have said probably that you specialise in supporting people going through fitness to practice proceedings.
sentences.zh: 我可能应该提一下，你专门为经历胜任能力听证程序的人提供支持。

sentences.en: Now,
sentences.zh: 现在，

sentences.en: something that people might not be aware of is that there are still fitness to practice proceedings going on and kind of standards that you need to maintain even before you become professionally regulated with the HCPC.
sentences.zh: 人们可能没有意识到的一点是，在成为HCPC法定注册专业人员之前，仍然存在胜任能力听证程序以及你需要维持的标准。

sentences.en: And so what we're finding is that people that are trainee clinical psychologists or the trainee paramedics or whatever are coming up against fitness to practice proceedings and then finding,
sentences.zh: 所以我们发现，临床心理学实习生或急救护理实习生等正在遭遇胜任能力听证程序，然后发现，

sentences.en: oh, I kind of fit in the middle of everything.
sentences.zh: 哦，我好像处在各种事情的夹缝中间。

sentences.en: So I'm not yet under HCPC.
sentences.zh: 所以我还不受HCPC管辖。

sentences.en: You know, I don't necessarily feel like the uni are on my side, maybe my placement supervisors are maybe not on my side.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我并不觉得大学站在我这边，我的实习督导可能也不站在我这边。

sentences.en: And they're feeling really quite unsupported.
sentences.zh: 他们感到非常缺乏支持。

sentences.en: So what we're kind of looking to do is have a broad conversation around pre-qualified fitness to practice proceedings today, aren't we, Nicola?
sentences.zh: 因此，我们今天要广泛讨论的是取得资质前的胜任能力听证程序，对吧，尼古拉？

sentences.en: I guess it's a really interesting area where people are really in a sort of grey zone where they don't have all the regulatory support that you have when you're with an institution,
sentences.zh: 我想这是一个非常有趣的领域，人们真正处于一种灰色地带，他们没有像加入某个机构时那样全面的监管支持，

sentences.en: for example, the HCPC.
sentences.zh: 例如HCPC。

sentences.en: You feel like you're in limbo a little bit, so you're actually entitled to support from the university.
sentences.zh: 你会觉得自己有点处于悬而未决的状态，所以你实际上有权获得大学的支持。

sentences.en: And at the same time, they are regulating and making sure that they adequately prepare professionals as they move forward.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们也在进行监管，并确保在专业人员向前发展时为他们做好充分准备。

sentences.en: FTP process applies to both pre-regulated and regulated practitioners.
sentences.zh: 胜任能力听证程序既适用于注册前人员，也适用于已注册的从业人员。

sentences.en: Yeah, OK.
sentences.zh: 是的，好的。

sentences.en: OK, but the HCPC aren't there for you until you're regulated, which puts you in a, I think, a tricky position.
sentences.zh: 好的，但在你注册之前，HCPC并不会为你提供支持，我认为这让你陷入了一个棘手的处境。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I guess the kind of work I deal with at the moment when it comes to students or those who are beginning their training, trainees,
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我想我目前处理的学生或刚开始培训的人、实习生的相关工作，

sentences.en: is that they're not being regulated by the HCPC, therefore meaning that the standards that existed with the HCPC,
sentences.zh: 是他们不受HCPC监管，这意味着HCPC现有的标准，

sentences.en: while incorporated into the university programs, are not actually, it's not as clear to them actually what they should be doing.
sentences.zh: 虽然被纳入了大学课程，但实际上对他们来说并不那么明确，他们不清楚自己应该做什么。

sentences.en: So I guess the first issue that I think we probably should look at is really the fact that there's no national university FTP regime.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我们可能应该探讨的第一个问题是，确实没有全国统一的大学胜任能力听证制度。

sentences.en: So we're well aware when we're practitioners with the HCPC or any other regulator, there's standards you have to adhere to.
sentences.zh: 因此，当我们作为HCPC或任何其他监管机构的从业人员时，我们很清楚必须遵守的标准。

sentences.en: And you also know enforcement of those standards is going to be with the HCPC or with the dental organisations or with the doctors.
sentences.zh: 并且你也知道这些标准的执行将由HCPC、牙科组织或医生协会来负责。

sentences.en: Now, the problem is when we have students who are in this grey zone, there's no single statutory body.
sentences.zh: 现在的问题是，当我们的学生处于这个灰色地带时，并没有单一的法定机构。

sentences.en: There's no single guideline about how these processes are run should you fall into FTP probleMs.
sentences.zh: 如果你陷入胜任能力问题，并没有单一的准则来规范这些流程是如何运行的。

sentences.en: And I think that leads to a bit of some unfairness across the board in terms of different universities address FTP in a different way.
sentences.zh: 我认为这导致了全面的某种不公，因为不同的大学以不同的方式处理胜任能力问题。

sentences.en: Issues in relation to how they deal with neurodivergence in terms of how they deal with people of different backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 关于他们如何处理神经多样性问题，以及他们如何对待不同背景的人的问题。

sentences.en: That can depend on what university you go to.
sentences.zh: 这可能取决于你上的是哪所大学。

sentences.en: We know when we're in the HCPC, these are the standards, this is how it's regulated, this is how it's enforced.
sentences.zh: 我们知道在HCPC中，这些就是标准，这就是监管方式，这就是执行方式。

sentences.en: When you're in the university process, it's unclear and that can lead to a lot of anxiety with students,
sentences.zh: 当你在大学流程中时，这一切并不明确，这会给学生带来很多焦虑，

sentences.en: particularly when you combine that with being in the last year of your practice, of your traineeship.
sentences.zh: 特别是当你把这一点与实习的最后一年结合起来时。

sentences.en: For clinical psychologists, for example, if you're in the last six, nine months, we all know how hectic that period is in your life.
sentences.zh: 例如，对于临床心理学家来说，如果你处于最后六、九个月，我们都知道你生活中的那段时期是多么忙碌。

sentences.en: You obviously know that better than me, but you're managing family, work, caseloads, new challenges that you've never faced before.
sentences.zh: 你显然比我更清楚这一点，你要应付家庭、工作、病案量、从未遇到过的新挑战。

sentences.en: And that's when things, health issues can become a problem.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时候，健康问题可能会成为一个问题。

sentences.en: That's when issues related to communication might be emphasised.
sentences.zh: 正是在那个时候，与沟通相关的问题可能会被放大。

sentences.en: And that's when you can fall down with the FTP regime.
sentences.zh: 也正是在那个时候，你可能会在胜任能力制度上栽跟头。

sentences.en: So it's something that people have very little knowledge about, this student FTP regime.
sentences.zh: 所以这是人们知之甚少的事情，这个学生胜任能力制度。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think it is that ambiguity, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为这就是那种含糊不清的地方，对吧？

sentences.en: It's like you don't necessarily know where you're aiming for.
sentences.zh: 就好像你并不一定知道你的目标是什么。

sentences.en: And I think it just reminded me of all of the different plates that I had spinning when I was a trainee.
sentences.zh: 我想这让我想起了我当实习生时同时在维持的所有不同事情。

sentences.en: So I'd moved away from my family and my support systems to come and do the course.
sentences.zh: 为了来上这门课，我搬离了家人和支持系统。

sentences.en: I was single when I first started the course.
sentences.zh: 刚开始上课时我是单身。

sentences.en: And then you're suddenly kind of trying to immerse yourself in cohort life.
sentences.zh: 然后你突然试图让自己沉浸在同辈群体的生活中。

sentences.en: So with the people that are on your training in your year at the same time, you're also trying to slot into university life.
sentences.zh: 所以要和同年级、同时参加培训的人相处，你还要努力融入大学生活。

sentences.en: So the demands of kind of academia and, you know,
sentences.zh: 因此，学术研究的要求，你知道，

sentences.en: the interactions you might be having with your personal tutor and then actually attending university lectures and seminars as well.
sentences.zh: 你可能与个人导师进行的互动，然后还要去上大学的讲座和研讨会。

sentences.en: And then you've, of course, once you get to the right stage of things, you're starting placements and you've got work with your clients and then you've got work within your team,
sentences.zh: 当然，一旦你到了合适的阶段，你就要开始实习，你得处理客户的工作，然后你得在团队中工作，

sentences.en: your MDT, and then you've got the actual client work as well.
sentences.zh: 你的多学科团队（MDT），然后还有实际的客户工作。

sentences.en: And then you've actually got your own life as well that you've somehow kind of got to try and bolt into all of those.
sentences.zh: 然后你实际上还有自己的生活，你不知怎么地必须试图把这些塞进所有这些事情中去。

sentences.en: So obviously it's a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以这显然非常繁重。

sentences.en: Without breaking any confidentiality,
sentences.zh: 在不违反保密原则的前提下，

sentences.en: if we could just give like a couple of examples of the kind of fitness to practice things that you're seeing or that might be common to see for people pre-qualification,
sentences.zh: 如果我们能举几个你在预备资格阶段看到或常见的胜任能力问题的例子，

sentences.en: if you can, Nicholas.
sentences.zh: 如果你可以的话，尼古拉。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, you've summed it up perfectly about how that works, that stage of the trainee's completion of their course.
sentences.zh: 好的，我的意思是，你非常完美地总结了实习生完成课程的那个阶段是如何运作的。

sentences.en: So you can imagine the trainee is seeing the finishing line and obviously this can be, you know, this has been the buildup to their life's expectation,
sentences.zh: 所以你可以想象，实习生看到了终点线，显然这可能是，你知道，这一直是他们生活中的期望积累，

sentences.en: particularly in my experience with psychologists because, you know, it's part of, it becomes essentially an integral part of who they are.
sentences.zh: 特别是根据我与心理学家的经验，因为，你知道，这构成了他们本质上不可或缺的一部分。

sentences.en: So they can see the finishing line, they're putting in all this hard work and then the stress starts to become a major factor.
sentences.zh: 所以他们能看到终点线，他们付出了所有的努力，然后压力开始成为一个主要因素。

sentences.en: Anxiety becomes a factor.
sentences.zh: 焦虑成了一个因素。

sentences.en: The fact that you're now taking on caseload yourself becomes a serious factor, as I said.
sentences.zh: 正如我所说，你现在开始自己承担病案量，这成了一个严重的因素。

sentences.en: And if you have any, for example, issues with anxieties, issues with the communication, as I mentioned before, some neurodivergence, ADHD, autism,
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，例如焦虑问题、正如我之前提到的沟通问题、某些神经多样性、ADHD、自闭症，

sentences.en: and whether it's some mental health issues, whether you've actually acknowledged that with university, and some people have, some people haven't.
sentences.zh: 以及是否有任何心理健康问题，无论你是否已向大学确认过，有些人确认了，有些人没有。

sentences.en: Some people have reasonable adjustment and they've done it and they've acknowledged it and it's part of the process.
sentences.zh: 有些人得到了合理的调整，他们做了并且确认了，这是流程的一部分。

sentences.en: Other people haven't.
sentences.zh: 其他人则没有。

sentences.en: And so this can be sort of accentuated and accelerate at this point in time.
sentences.zh: 因此，这种状况在这个时间点可能会被加剧和加速。

sentences.en: And in my experience with my diverse range of clients, it tends to be in this final phase where things can really reach a point of becoming an FTP matter.
sentences.zh: 根据我与形形色色的客户打交道的经验，往往正是在这个最后阶段，事情真正达到了演变成胜任能力问题的地步。

sentences.en: So the types of issues that I deal with regularly often relate to communication.
sentences.zh: 所以我经常处理的问题类型通常与沟通有关。

sentences.en: Now, I think using that as a first example, and I'll move on to some others later.
sentences.zh: 现在，我认为以此作为第一个例子，我稍后会继续谈其他例子。

sentences.en: So communication can be how you deal with your supervisor.
sentences.zh: 因此，沟通可能是你如何与督导相处。

sentences.en: Communication can be how you're dealing with other students.
sentences.zh: 沟通可能是你如何与其他学生相处。

sentences.en: Communication can be how you're dealing with clients.
sentences.zh: 沟通可能是你如何与客户相处。

sentences.en: Now, anecdotally, and also in discussing with other colleagues, it's my experience that, you know,
sentences.zh: 现在，根据经验轶事，以及在与其他同事的讨论中，我的经验是，你知道，

sentences.en: over proportionate representation of clients that I have are people who are neurodivergent in this area.
sentences.zh: 我接待的客户中，神经多样性人群的代表比例过高。

sentences.en: And while that's obviously not a topic for everyone, I think it's worth understanding for practitioners as well as people who run, who have trainees themselves,
sentences.zh: 虽然这显然不是针对所有人的话题，但我认为对于从业人员以及那些自己管理实习生的人，或者，

sentences.en: or, you know, people having difficulty with anxiety, people having students really having difficulty, some other unmanaged health condition.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有焦虑困难的学生，真正遇到困难的学生，或者其他未得到妥善控制的健康状况的人来说，了解这一点是值得的。

sentences.en: So those that I see that have reached this stage, generally, if it is not to do with a dishonesty, a clear dishonesty, they've plagiarized, they've stolen something.
sentences.zh: 我所看到的那些达到这个阶段的人，一般来说，如果这不涉及不诚实、明显的欺骗、抄袭、偷窃等行为。

sentences.en: And, you know, their FTP matters and universities deal with those and they, you know, rightfully should not be admitted if they've really broken the rules.
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道，他们的胜任能力问题由大学处理，如果他们真的违反了规则，他们理应不被录取。

sentences.en: But those sort of clear-cut cases are less interesting, I think, because we all know when someone's stolen a computer or someone's forged notes on a, you know, that's,
sentences.zh: 但那些泾渭分明的案例我认为没那么有趣，因为我们都知道当有人偷了一台电脑或伪造了笔记时，那就是，

sentences.en: we don't want that type of person.
sentences.zh: 我们不想要那种人。

sentences.en: You know, there may be some other issues involved, but, you know, we can't accept that in terms of public protection.
sentences.zh: 你知道，可能还涉及其他一些问题，但是，为了公共保护，我们不能接受这一点。

sentences.en: But if you have someone who's communicating in their mind appropriately with staff, but in the eyes of the staff, there's a rudeness, there's a lack of transparency,
sentences.zh: 但如果你有一个人，他在自己看来是在以恰当的方式与员工沟通，但在员工眼中，这是一种粗鲁、缺乏透明度，

sentences.en: that can escalate quite quickly.
sentences.zh: 这可能会相当迅速地升级。

sentences.en: And I think that's worth people understanding that what can start off as being a communication issue, an email, inappropriate emails, can, when the process begins,
sentences.zh: 我认为值得人们理解的是，一个本可以从沟通问题、一封邮件、不当邮件开始的事情，当程序启动时，

sentences.en: which is normally, it's raised with the student, there's a complaint raised and it goes to an informal meeting.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，这是向学生提出的，提出了投诉并进入了非正式会议。

sentences.en: And that informal meeting is intended to solve that problem.
sentences.zh: 而那次非正式会议旨在解决这个问题。

sentences.en: There might be some sort of improvement plan.
sentences.zh: 可能会有一些改进计划。

sentences.en: It's really, how can we help the student?
sentences.zh: 这实际上是，我们如何才能帮助学生？

sentences.en: That's the mentality of the university.
sentences.zh: 这就是大学的心态。

sentences.en: How do we help the student past this stage?
sentences.zh: 我们如何帮助学生度过这个阶段？

sentences.en: But if the student does not really have the same understanding of the issues that they may have presented, for example, if they are, have some neurodivergence,
sentences.zh: 但如果学生对他们可能表现出的问题并没有真正相同的理解，例如，如果他们，有一些神经多样性，

sentences.en: or if they just view their whole incident differently, that can escalate.
sentences.zh: 或者如果他们对整个事件有不同的看法，这可能会升级。

sentences.en: Because the way these matters stop at each step in the process, stage one, which is the informal process, and then stage two, which becomes an FTP process, is the idea of insight.
sentences.zh: 因为这些事情在流程的每一步停下来的方式——第一阶段是内部非正式流程，然后是第二阶段，变成胜任能力流程——其核心理念就是洞察力。

sentences.en: So you need to not only understand you've made a mistake, but have rectified and remediated that mistake.
sentences.zh: 所以你不仅需要明白自己犯了错误，还需要纠正并补救这个错误。

sentences.en: So issues of communication, issues of health issues as well, in terms of unmanaged conditions, they often lead to FTP matters.
sentences.zh: 因此，沟通问题，以及失控健康状况方面的健康问题，经常会导致胜任能力问题。

sentences.en: But I think the most interesting one is in terms of attitudinal issues, because what the universities will say is they will say, well,
sentences.zh: 但我认为最有趣的是态度问题，因为大学会说的是，他们会说，

sentences.en: this person is not presenting as professional.
sentences.zh: 这个人表现得不够专业。

sentences.en: And that's an interesting idea, which I'm sure you have some points about, in terms of what kind of psychologist are we trying to create?
sentences.zh: 这是一个有趣的观点，我相信你对此有一些看法，关于我们究竟在试图培养什么样的心理学家？

sentences.en: What do we want to go out into the world?
sentences.zh: 我们希望什么样的人走向世界？

sentences.en: Is the university educating and creating a particular type of psychologist?
sentences.zh: 大学是在教育和培养一种特定类型的心理学家吗？

sentences.en: Or is it also, its perfunctory role is also to regulate?
sentences.zh: 还是说它的例行职责也包括监管？

sentences.en: And they can sort of cross paths and they can become complicated.
sentences.zh: 这两者有时会交叉，从而变得复杂。

sentences.en: So, you know, are we trying to create a psychologist who fits a professional norm moving forward?
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们是在努力培养一个符合未来专业规范的心理学家吗？

sentences.en: Or are we trying to create someone who understands the various conditions that exist in psychology?
sentences.zh: 还是我们在努力培养一个理解心理学中存在的各种状况的人？

sentences.en: And that's something that I'm sure you can comment on.
sentences.zh: 我相信你可以对此发表评论。

sentences.en: And there can be a bit of a diversion there.
sentences.zh: 这里可能会出现一些分歧。

sentences.en: So, FTP processes, when someone is acting, what do I say, differently, eye contact, can they actually, you know, are they masking, using a psychological term,
sentences.zh: 所以，胜任能力流程中，当某人的行为，我该怎么说，表现不同、眼神接触异常，他们实际上，你知道，他们是在掩饰吗——用心理学的术语来说，

sentences.en: and are they going to be able to be an appropriate, safe psychologist?
sentences.zh: 他们能够成为一个合格的、安全的心理学家吗？

sentences.en: And I would argue that some of these people are being fully foul of the FTP process and are being excluded from the profession because of whatever nuanced difference they may have.
sentences.zh: 我会认为，其中一些人因为他们可能存在的任何细微差异，而正在陷入胜任能力流程的泥潭，并被排除在行业之外。

sentences.en: So, that's a broader discussion that maybe you can comment on in terms of what type of psychologist we're wanting and whether the current system,
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一个更广泛的讨论，也许你可以就我们想要什么样的心理学家以及现有系统、

sentences.en: the current regime is adequately preparing the profession for what these types of people are producing.
sentences.zh: 现有制度是否在为这些类型的人所产生的影响充分准备这个行业，发表你的看法。

sentences.en: Yeah, that is a really good point.
sentences.zh: 是的，这真的是一个很好的观点。

sentences.en: And, you know, I do so much work around inclusion and how psychologists don't all need to look the same.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我围绕包容性做了很多工作，比如心理学家并不都需要长得一模一样。

sentences.en: And I'm aware that people that might have been qualified for a longer period of time might have different views around what, you know,
sentences.zh: 我也意识到，那些资格更老的人可能会对“什么对心理学家来说才算足够好”或“心理学家的标准应该是什么”，

sentences.en: is good enough for a psychologist or what the standards should be for a psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 持有不同的看法。

sentences.en: And I'm really aware of the emerging literature around use of swearing, for example,
sentences.zh: 我非常清楚围绕使用脏话的新兴文献，例如，

sentences.en: and actually lots of clients can find it really helps them let their guard down if a clinician will swear when they're talking to them.
sentences.zh: 实际上，如果临床医生在与他们交谈时说脏话，很多客户会发现这真的有助于他们放下戒备。

sentences.en: But, obviously, you know, some people are swearier than others.
sentences.zh: 但显然，你知道，有些人比其他人更喜欢说脏话。

sentences.en: Some people find that very, very offensive.
sentences.zh: 有些人觉得这非常非常冒犯。

sentences.en: And I can imagine that if someone was very sweary, you know, in interpersonal meetings in the corridors and in MDT meetings, that might come across as antagonistic or rude.
sentences.zh: 我能想象，如果有人在走廊里、在多学科团队会议的人际交往中满口脏话，这可能会显得具有对抗性或粗鲁。

sentences.en: Well, in actual fact, for lots of people,
sentences.zh: 然而事实上，对很多人来说，

sentences.en: it's just a way of punctuating almost and adding nuance to discussions or really trying to connect with someone isn't necessarily supposed to be offensive in the way that other people might view it as offensive.
sentences.zh: 这几乎只是一种标点符号的使用方式，为讨论增添了细微差别，或者真正试图与人建立联系，它并不一定像其他人认为的那样具有攻击性。

sentences.en: So I think even that is a good example about how there can be that miscommunication and maybe just different comfortability curves, I think, with normal human behaviour.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为连这也很好地说明了如何会出现这种沟通不畅，以及对于正常人类行为可能存在不同的舒适度曲线。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: I think that's a great example.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是一个很好的例子。

sentences.en: You know, I personally, I'm Australian, so I grew up in a culture where, you know, it is a means of lowering barriers.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我个人是澳大利亚人，所以我是在一种将说脏话作为打破隔阂手段的文化中长大的。

sentences.en: And that's just the way it is.
sentences.zh: 事情就是这样。

sentences.en: You know, when you're in a familiar situation, when I'm with my parents, that we tend to, the language is different as when I'm in a court.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你处在一个熟悉的环境中，当我和父母在一起时，我们的语言和我在法庭上时是不同的。

sentences.en: And it can often be a way of showing, hey, we're letting our guard down.
sentences.zh: 这通常是一种展现“嘿，我们正在卸下防备”的方式。

sentences.en: So it's something I actually really identify with.
sentences.zh: 所以我对这一点其实非常有共鸣。

sentences.en: In terms of, yeah, the communication norms and generally what norms are,
sentences.zh: 从交流规范以及普遍的规范是什么的角度来看，

sentences.en: and the reason why it's interesting to me as a legal practitioner is when FTP is about regulating accepted norms, which it is,
sentences.zh: 我作为一名法律从业者觉得它很有意思的原因在于，当适应性培训（FTP）旨在规范被接受的规范时——确实如此——

sentences.en: and we understand that there are certain standards that must be upheld, we need to also have some form of flexibility in there as well.
sentences.zh: 并且我们理解有些标准必须坚持，我们也需要在其中保持某种形式的灵活性。

sentences.en: So I know, for example, I have some clients of different ethnic backgrounds, different religions, and there has, while there's no overt discrimination,
sentences.zh: 所以据我所知，例如，我有一些来自不同族裔背景、不同宗教信仰的客户，虽然没有公开的歧视——

sentences.en: obviously that's a much more serious matter, there is a gentle, there is, I would argue, on the behalf of some universities, not all,
sentences.zh: 显然那是一个严重得多问题——但存在一种温和的、我认为在某些大学（并非全部）代表的立场，

sentences.en: and obviously these places are some of the forefront thinkers about how we deal with discrimination and how to best equip students.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，这些地方在如何处理歧视以及如何最好地装备学生方面，处于思想的最前沿。

sentences.en: So I don't want to label all, you know, universities are great places, the ones that eventually, where they may, there may be some slight issues, is, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以我不想一概而论，你知道的，大学都是好地方；最终可能出现一些微小问题的地方在于，

sentences.en: accepting that some supervisors, some members of academia, outside of strict guidelines, you know, may not actually,
sentences.zh: 承认某些导师、学术界的某些成员，在严格的指导方针之外，实际上可能不会——

sentences.en: may see norms in a slightly different way to some of these students, or some of these trainees.
sentences.zh: 可能会以略微不同于其中某些学生或某些实习生的方式来看待规范。

sentences.en: Okay, so I mean, another example of this idea of norms and, you know, people's perceptions, and I would argue their lived experiences, using a case example I've had,
sentences.zh: 好吧，我的意思是，这个关于规范以及人们看法的想法的另一个例子，结合我经手过的一个案例来看，我会说他们有切身的经历，

sentences.en: is with a client who felt excluded from group work, felt somewhat not discriminated, because discrimination would obviously be a far more serious matter,
sentences.zh: 即有一个客户觉得自己被群组工作排挤了，感觉自己受到了一些并非歧视的对待，因为歧视显然是一个严重得多的问题，

sentences.en: and then we're bringing in, you know, that becomes a different level of complaint by the student.
sentences.zh: 然后我们引入了——你知道的，这就变成了学生投诉的不同层面。

sentences.en: But really feeling that her experience as her, in this example, her, but I've had other examples with a male,
sentences.zh: 但真正让人觉得她的经历——在这个例子中是她，但我也有过男性的其他例子——

sentences.en: their experience was that there was a lack of real recognition of how others felt, others dealt with them during Ramadan in this particular example,
sentences.zh: 他们的经历是，在这个特定的例子中，别人在斋月期间对他们的感受和对待缺乏真正的认可，

sentences.en: but I've had other examples where they were going through a personal issue, and people were not actually communicating with them appropriately.
sentences.zh: 但我也遇到过其他例子，他们正在经历个人问题，而人们实际上并没有以合适的方式与他们沟通。

sentences.en: So that led to a distrust from the client, which led to lashing out at various people, and led to an escalation very quickly.
sentences.zh: 这导致客户产生了不信任，进而对不同的人恶语相向，并且导致情况迅速升级。

sentences.en: So in terms of what, you know, this client was perceived as rude during this time period, and again, this may be a particular example,
sentences.zh: 所以在这一时期，这位客户被认为很粗鲁，再次强调，这可能是一个特例，

sentences.en: but I think it sort of exemplifies the types of issues that we're dealing with.
sentences.zh: 但我认为它在某种程度上体现了我们正在处理的问题类型。

sentences.en: Every trainee is an individual person with their own individual idiosyncrasies, or their own individual cultural identity, and having a, you know,
sentences.zh: 每个实习生都是一个独立的个体，有其独特的性格特点，或者他们自己的独特文化身份，并且拥有一个——你知道的，

sentences.en: being able to listen to these people having their lived experiences as psychologists, and not having a standard of particular psychologists that we all need to,
sentences.zh: 能够倾听这些人作为心理学家的切身经历，而不是拥有一套我们所有人都必须达到的特定心理学家的标准——

sentences.en: that the university is trying to produce, I think is something universities could strive towards a little bit more,
sentences.zh: 这是大学正在努力塑造的标准，我认为这是大学可以再多努力一点的方向，

sentences.en: because they're the ones that tend to fall foul of this FTP process.
sentences.zh: 因为他们往往是最终陷入这个 FTP 流程困境的人。

sentences.en: Particularly in terms of universities.
sentences.zh: 特别是在大学方面。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: And I want to just obviously, give a nod to the fact that this is a really difficult, really stressful experience for the person that's undergoing the FTP investigation,
sentences.zh: 显然，我想表达的是，对于经历 FTP 调查的人来说，这是一段非常艰难、压力极大的经历，

sentences.en: but also probably for the people around them are having to raise that this isn't something that people do lightly.
sentences.zh: 但对于他们周围那些不得不提出这一点的人来说可能也是如此，这不是人们会轻率对待的事情。

sentences.en: And I think I've spoken publicly already that I had an experience on one of my placements where at my mid-placement review, the question was, you know,
sentences.zh: 我想我已经公开说过，我在实习期间有过这样一次经历：在我的中期实习评估中，问题是，

sentences.en: is there a chance that the trainee might fail this placement?
sentences.zh: 实习生有没有可能无法通过这次实习？

sentences.en: And the answer was yes.
sentences.zh: 而回答是肯定的。

sentences.en: And I was like, I was horrified because it hadn't been communicated to me before.
sentences.zh: 我当时惊呆了，因为之前根本没有人跟我沟通。靴

sentences.en: And my experience after that was that I really just found everything very difficult after that for for a number of weeks, until it was resolved.
sentences.zh: 在那之后的经历中，我真的发现之后的好几周一切都变得非常艰难，直到问题得到解决。

sentences.en: And it can kind of make you a little bit paranoid about whether other people are thinking that you're not good enough, or, you know,
sentences.zh: 这会让你变得有点偏执，担心别人是否认为你不够优秀，或者，

sentences.en: whether other people have been part of this and having conversations about you and, you know, comparisons to other people that might be seeming to get it right more effortlessly.
sentences.zh: 是否其他人也参与其中并在背后议论你，以及，你知道的，与那些似乎能更毫不费力地掌握要领的人进行比较。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It isn't easy, and it can impact on not just your work, but all of your outside life as well.
sentences.zh: 这并不容易，它不仅会影响你的工作，还会影响你所有的外部生活。

sentences.en: It isn't easy, isn't it, Nicholas?
sentences.zh: 这很不简单，对吧，尼古拉斯？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I guess that that raises the greater question of what is the purpose of these universities?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我猜这引发了一个更宏大的问题：这些大学的目的是什么？

sentences.en: Are they there to support students or are they there to protect the public?
sentences.zh: 它们是为了支持学生，还是为了保护公众？

sentences.en: And I think, obviously, it's a twofold process.
sentences.zh: 我认为，显而易见，这是一个双重的过程。

sentences.en: They're there to support students, create the right type of professionals that we all want to see, particularly in, you know, vital roles,
sentences.zh: 它们旨在支持学生，培养我们都希望看到的正确类型的专业人士，尤其是在诸如——

sentences.en: such as psychology or across the healthcare profession, you're dealing with vulnerable people and your role is really important.
sentences.zh: 诸如心理学或整个医疗保健行业等关键岗位上，你面对的是弱势群体，你的角色非常重要。

sentences.en: But I guess in terms of how do we support a student through a process?
sentences.zh: 但我想，就我们如何在一个流程中支持学生而言？

sentences.en: How do we support a student in whatever may be happening in their personal lives, whatever may be happening in their physical and mental health,
sentences.zh: 我们如何支持一个在个人生活中可能遭遇变故、在身心健康上可能遇到问题的小伙伴，

sentences.en: while at the same time ensuring that, wait a sec, once they're finished with the process, once the trainees has completed their training, they're going to be safe,
sentences.zh: 同时确保——等一下，一旦他们完成了这个流程，一旦实习生完成了培训，他们将是安全的，

sentences.en: because that's really a really, really important factor.
sentences.zh: 因为这真的是一个非常非常重要的因素。

sentences.en: And I think everyone understands that.
sentences.zh: 我想每个人都能理解这一点。

sentences.en: And that's, you know, it's often a question that when I feel, when I hear anger from clients, whether they'll be trainees or whether they're qualified registrants,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，每当我听到客户（无论是实习生还是已注册的执业人员）的愤怒时，这往往是一个问题：

sentences.en: once they have an understanding of the idea that the HCPC or in this circumstance, that the university isn't, that they're performing a role that we all support,
sentences.zh: 一旦他们理解了 HCPC 或在这种情况下大学并非在——它们在履行我们都支持的职责，

sentences.en: which is protecting the public.
sentences.zh: 也就是保护公众。

sentences.en: It's about how to do.
sentences.zh: 关键在于如何去做。

sentences.en: It's about how that is actually managed and whether, you know, enough is done to make sure that they're being supported through the process,
sentences.zh: 关键在于这究竟是如何管理的，以及——你知道的——是否做了足够的工作来确保他们在整个过程中得到支持，

sentences.en: while also managing what is essentially future risk.
sentences.zh: 同时也管理着本质上属于未来的风险。

sentences.en: That's the thing that's quite complicated to assess, particularly for clients, is when we're looking at remediation or insight in terms of an FTP matter, it's not how you are now.
sentences.zh: 正是这一点评估起来相当复杂，特别是对客户而言：当我们审视 FTP 事项的整改或洞察时，重点不在于你现在的状态。

sentences.en: You may have said, I'm sorry for that particular issue.
sentences.zh: 你可能已经说过，对于那个特定的问题我感到很抱歉。

sentences.en: I will improve my communication, I'll improve my note taking, I'll improve my punctuality, my data protection, whatever it may be.
sentences.zh: 我会改进我的沟通，我会改进我的笔记记录，我会改进我的守时性、我的数据保护，无论具体是什么。

sentences.en: But I haven't rectified, I haven't remediated the issue that exists.
sentences.zh: 但我还没有纠正、没有弥补已经存在的问题。

sentences.en: So that's, managing that for universities is very difficult.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于大学来说，管理这一点非常困难。

sentences.en: I don't deny that, you know, they do their beSt.
sentences.zh: 我不否认，你知道的，他们已经尽力了。

sentences.en: But I think when we have a system which is completely different across, I mean, not completely different, but varies across universities, not a standardized HCPC system,
sentences.zh: 但我觉得，当我们拥有一个在各个大学之间完全不同——我的意思是，不是完全不同，但在各所大学之间有所差异的系统，而不是一个标准化的 HCPC 系统时，

sentences.en: how students, trainees, various people, whatever stage of their training they may be, how they deal with the FTP process varies.
sentences.zh: 学生、实习生、形形色色的人，无论处于培训的哪个阶段，他们如何应对 FTP 流程都是各不相同的。

sentences.en: So when I, and the reason why a lot of practitioners, in terms of legal advisors or solicitors, steer away from students,
sentences.zh: 因此，当我和许多从业者（就法律顾问或诉讼律师而言）避开学生时，

sentences.en: is not necessarily because of the fact that students don't make, you know, they're not in need of assistance, it's that you have different guidelines for every university.
sentences.zh: 并不一定是因为学生不需要帮助，而是因为每所大学都有不同的指导方针。

sentences.en: So am I dealing with Reading today?
sentences.zh: 所以我今天是在和雷丁大学打交道吗？

sentences.en: Am I dealing with Swansea?
sentences.zh: 我是和斯旺西大学打交道吗？

sentences.en: Am I dealing with, and that to me feels a little bit unfair, because you have a standardized system once they're registered.
sentences.zh: 我是和——这对我来说感觉有点不公平，因为一旦他们注册了，你就会有一个标准化的系统。

sentences.en: But before registration, it's not standardized, and how well people are deal, how well panels or universities deal with reasonable adjustment, how well they deal with,
sentences.zh: 但在注册之前，它不是标准化的，人们处理得怎么样——听证小组或大学在处理合理调整方面的表现如何，他们处理得如何——

sentences.en: or how forcefully they enforce some of their, say, note-taking guidelines, and these types of things vary.
sentences.zh: 或者他们多大程度上强制执行他们的一些准则（比如笔记记录准则）以及诸如此类的事情，这些都是千差万别的。

sentences.en: And I'm not sure that's fair, and I have colleagues who work in the industry and deal a lot with students, and they would argue that it's a rogue world.
sentences.zh: 我不确定这是否公平，我有一些在业内工作并经常与学生打交道的同事，他们会认为这是一个无法无天的世界。

sentences.en: I wouldn't go that far, but they'd argue that this is, it's a bit of a, it's in the nether region there.
sentences.zh: 我不会走得那么远，但他们会认为这有点——处于灰色地带。

sentences.en: You don't really know what you're going to deal with, and that's not the right word.
sentences.zh: 你真的不知道你会遇到什么，而这并不是合适的词。

sentences.en: I enjoy, I enjoy the nether regions.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢——我喜欢灰色地带。

sentences.en: Let's leave it in.
sentences.zh: 让我们保留这个说法。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So you're in sort of a grey zone there, meaning that, you know, you don't know what laws are being enforced.
sentences.zh: 所以你有点身处灰色地带，这意味着，你知道的，你不知道到底在执行什么法律。

sentences.en: You essentially have to look at each guideline, and that can go in through each individual university processes, university guidelines, how they run it, and there's variations,
sentences.zh: 你基本上必须查看每一项指导方针，这可能会深入到各个大学的独立流程、大学指导方针以及他们如何运作中，并且存在差异，

sentences.en: and how they enforce it is different.
sentences.zh: 他们执行这些规定也是不同的。

sentences.en: And I would argue, and some of my colleagues would argue quite strongly, that that's, that's inherently unfair, and they make whatever decision they want.
sentences.zh: 我会说，我的一些同事也会强烈主张，这——这本质上是不公平的，他们会做出他们想要的任何决定。

sentences.en: And if there's a personal problem with that, with that particular trainee, then that's going to override anything else.
sentences.zh: 如果那个特定的实习生存在个人问题，那么这将会凌驾于一切之上。

sentences.en: And if that trainee, for example, has needed extra supervision for whatever reason, and it's caused a bit of a disruptions in the course, and there may be, yeah,
sentences.zh: 如果该实习生由于某种原因需要额外的监督，并且这在课程中引起了一些混乱，可能还会有——对，

sentences.en: a lot of people are unhappy with that person's behaviour, but it doesn't necessarily mean they're not going to be a great psychologist, that personal,
sentences.zh: 很多人对那个人的行为不满意，但这并不一定意味着他们不会成为一名优秀的心理学家，那种个人——

sentences.en: that personal relationship can't be overlooked.
sentences.zh: 那种个人关系是不能被忽视的。

sentences.en: So when, for example, a trainee may be at a final hearing, FTP final hearing at university, FTP proceedings, and the main evidence is being presented by a supervisor.
sentences.zh: 因此，举例来说，当实习生可能面临最终听证会、大学的 FTP 最终听证会、FTP 诉讼程序时，主要的证据是由一位导师提出的。

sentences.en: Now, we, this may be very evident, a very qualified, eminent, fantastic at her job, his job, whoever it may be, but if there's a personal issue there,
sentences.zh: 现在，我们，这可能非常明显——一位非常合格、杰出、在其岗位上非常出色的女性、男性或任何人，但如果其中存在个人问题，

sentences.en: then that is going to influence how the panel view that.
sentences.zh: 那么这将会影响听证小组对此事的看法。

sentences.en: And that's something that does not happen at the HCPC regulatory proceedings, or, you know, in a higher proceedings.
sentences.zh: 而这在 HCPC 的监管程序中，或者在更高级别的诉讼中是不会发生的。

sentences.en: So I think it's something that could be addressed, either through associations, like organisations like the ACP UK, or various representative bodies,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是一个可以通过各种协会（如 ACP UK 等组织）或各个代表机构来解决的问题，

sentences.en: about how can we manage this better?
sentences.zh: 探讨我们如何能更好地管理这一点？

sentences.en: Because, to me, it feels unfair, and it's disproportionately affecting those of different ethnic backgrounds, of, who have neurodivergence, who may, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为在我看来，这感觉很不公平，并且不成比例地影响了那些拥有不同族裔背景、患有神经多样性、可能——你知道的——

sentences.en: who may not conform to what we see as society's norMs.
sentences.zh: 可能不符合我们所认为的社会规范的人。

sentences.en: So it's something that I think should be looked into.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是一个应该被深入调查的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think another issue that I kind of struggled to get my head around is the fact that for people that are not self-funding, their employer will be the NHS,
sentences.zh: 对，我认为另一个让我有点难以理解的问题是，对于那些不能自己支付学费的人来说，他们的雇主将是 NHS，

sentences.en: certainly for trainee clinical psychologists anyway.
sentences.zh: 至少对临床心理学实习生来说绝对是这样。

sentences.en: But it might well be that the procedures are being raised by a university.
sentences.zh: 但这些程序很可能是由大学发起的。

sentences.en: And I presume, I can't, it's been too long, I can't remember, I don't know if I signed some stuff to say that I would be a good girl when I was training with my university,
sentences.zh: 我推测——不可能，时间太久了，我记不清了，我不知道自己在大学培训时是否签署过某些文件来保证我会做一个乖女孩，

sentences.en: as well as my employer, or whether I only signed a contract with my NHS.
sentences.zh: 既对我的雇主负责，也对我的大学负责，还是说我只跟我的 NHS 签了合同。

sentences.en: I feel like I only did that.
sentences.zh: 我感觉我当时只做了那个。

sentences.en: But it might have changed more recently.
sentences.zh: 但最近可能有所改变。

sentences.en: But then you're in a position where the university are not your employer, and yet are obviously holding you to account.
sentences.zh: 然而，你随后会处于这样一种境地：大学并非你的雇主，却显然在要求你承担责任。

sentences.en: And then you might be in a position where you don't really have much control because of the power difference, especially if maybe you're, like you said,
sentences.zh: 接着你可能会处于这样一种处境：由于权力差异，你实际上并没有太多的控制权，尤其是当你可能——就像你说的，

sentences.en: if you and your supervisors just don't get along.
sentences.zh: 如果你和你的导师根本合不来。

sentences.en: And, like, you know, if you met each other 100 times across different years, you still would hate each other.
sentences.zh: 而且，就像，你知道的，如果你在不同的年份里遇到彼此 100 次，你们仍然会讨厌对方。

sentences.en: Like, it's just a personality mismatch.
sentences.zh: 就像，这纯粹是性格不合。

sentences.en: And then there really is inequity.
sentences.zh: 然后就真的存在不平等了。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I 100% agree.
sentences.zh: 我百分之百同意。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对的。

sentences.en: I mean, that sort of conflict between employer and university, particularly in the final years, the final months of training, which is across all professions.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，雇主与大学之间的这种冲突，尤其是在培训的最后几年、最后几个月，在所有行业中都存在。

sentences.en: But it's quite volatile in my experience with psychology, particularly clinical psychologists, because, you know, you're on the coalface.
sentences.zh: 但在我与心理学、特别是临床心理学的交往经验中，它是相当不稳定的，因为，你知道的，你正处于最前线。

sentences.en: You're dealing with vulnerable people, and also that your employer is, you know, they're trying to run an organisation.
sentences.zh: 你在和弱势群体打交道，而且你的雇主，你知道的，他们正在努力运营一个组织。

sentences.en: So the fact that you're in your final year of training, there is an understanding, hey, wait a second, this person is learning.
sentences.zh: 所以，鉴于你正处于培训的最后一年，人们有一种共识：嘿，等一下，这个人还在学习。

sentences.en: But in the eyes of an underfunded NHS trust in a particular department, they need this person to do their job properly,
sentences.zh: 但在资金不足的某特定部门的 NHS 信托机构眼中，他们需要这个人来正常完成工作，

sentences.en: that they're relying on them to have that particular caseload, 510, whatever the caseload may be.
sentences.zh: 他们指望这些人来处理特定的病例量，无论是 5 个、10 个还是无论多少病例量。

sentences.en: And the student may not be ready for that.
sentences.zh: 而学生可能还没有准备好应对这一切。

sentences.en: So the academic requirements from the university are too great, considering that the employer is actually asking, yeah, well, you're running a caseload now, and the university,
sentences.zh: 因此，考虑到雇主实际上在要求——对，好吧，你现在要负责处理病例量了，而大学的学术要求太高了，

sentences.en: and they're expecting a certain standard.
sentences.zh: 并且他们期望达到某个特定的标准。

sentences.en: And what I would argue, and what I do argue in final hearings regularly, and in our submissions and in our appeals, is that this person is still learning.
sentences.zh: 而我想要主张的，也是我在最终听证会、我们的意见书以及上诉中经常主张的是，这个人仍然在学习。

sentences.en: And so, you know, they're not the finished product yet.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，他们还不是成品。

sentences.en: They're not the finished professional.
sentences.zh: 他们还不是成熟的专业人士。

sentences.en: And then I feel like the conflict between the placement and the necessity to use their hands, their man hours, the fact that they're needed on the ground because of underfunding,
sentences.zh: 然后我觉得实习岗位与使用他们的人力、工时的必要性之间的冲突——由于资金不足，他们在实地工作时是必不可少的——

sentences.en: I would argue, and I'm sure that a lot of your listeners would agree with that.
sentences.zh: 我会说，而且我相信你的很多听众也会同意这一点。

sentences.en: They're asked to do too much too soon, and that leaves them open to, first of all, burnout, which is obviously a very common thing.
sentences.zh: 他们被要求在太短的时间内做太多的事情，这使他们首先容易遭遇职业倦怠，这显然是一个非常普遍的现象。

sentences.en: In my experience, I've seen people just quit the profession.
sentences.zh: 根据我的经验，我见过有人直接放弃这个职业。

sentences.en: Like, I really have seen that happen.
sentences.zh: 真的，我确实亲眼见过这种情况发生。

sentences.en: And also, you know, the expectations of maintaining this standard that they've never met before because they've never done it before.
sentences.zh: 还有，你知道的，期望他们保持从未达到过的标准，因为他们以前从未做过。

sentences.en: And in other professions, I'll give the example of a radiologist who I work with.
sentences.zh: 而在其他行业中，我举一个我合作过的放射科医师的例子。

sentences.en: In their final year, in their placements, you know, if they're taking a scan, for example, and determining whether this thing is, you know, what the type of growth it is, or,
sentences.zh: 在他们的最后一年，在他们的实习期中，你知道的，如果他们拍了一张扫描图，并判断这个东西——你知道的，这是哪种类型的增生，或者，

sentences.en: for example, whether it's a tear or whether it's a break, you know, that's probably going to be looked at by someone else briefly because it's not just a client-facing direct role.
sentences.zh: 比如说，它是撕裂还是骨折，你知道的，这可能会被其他人简短地审核一下，因为它不仅仅是一个直接面对客户的角色。

sentences.en: I imagine there's an extra layer of supervision.
sentences.zh: 我想会有额外的一层监督。

sentences.en: But if you are alone, your supervisor can't sit in on your one-on-one session.
sentences.zh: 但如果你是单独一人，你的导师是无法旁听你的一对一咨询的。

sentences.en: So it's a different type of, you know, it's real and it happens immediately.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种不同类型的——你知道的，这是真实的，而且是即时发生的。

sentences.en: So there's no means of sort of supervising that aspect of it.
sentences.zh: 因此，没有什么办法可以监督这一方面的运作。

sentences.en: And that can very quickly lead to conflict between both, between the university and the employer.
sentences.zh: 这很容易迅速导致大学与雇主之间的冲突。

sentences.en: Essentially, the employer going, well, I've got to raise this complaint because, look, you haven't done your job properly.
sentences.zh: 本质上是雇主觉得，好吧，我必须提出这个投诉，因为，你看，你没有把工作做好。

sentences.en: I've got to tell your university because they're asking how you're going and I'm writing the report.
sentences.zh: 我必须告诉你的大学，因为他们在询问你的进展，而且我在写报告。

sentences.en: And then all of a sudden you're in the process.
sentences.zh: 然后你突然就被卷入了这个流程中。

sentences.en: And it's hard to get out of because once you're on that FTP track, and again, this is, you don't want to scare people, trainees and students.
sentences.zh: 而且很难摆脱，因为一旦你走上了 FTP 的轨道——再次强调，你并不想吓唬大家、实习生和学生。

sentences.en: The majority of people will never encounter any FTP proceedings university.
sentences.zh: 大多数人永远不会遇到任何大学的 FTP 诉讼程序。

sentences.en: I mean, it's, but it does happen.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这——但这确实会发生。

sentences.en: And when it does happen, my advice would be from the outset is, you know,
sentences.zh: 当它确实发生时，我的建议是从一开始就是，你知道的，

sentences.en: the university present this initial informal chat as not being part of an FTP process because it's not really.
sentences.zh: 大学将最初的这次非正式谈话表现得好像不是 FTP 流程的一部分，因为它确实算不上。

sentences.en: But things that happen in that first informal meeting will dictate which track it goes on.
sentences.zh: 但那第一次非正式会议中发生的事情将决定它会走向哪一条轨道。

sentences.en: And once you're in that FTP process and that formal investigation is undertaken, yeah, the advice is to try and get some help,
sentences.zh: 一旦你卷入了 FTP 流程并开展了正式调查，对吧，建议是尽量寻求一些帮助，

sentences.en: whether it's through your student representatives or through legal advice or people who understand this process.
sentences.zh: 无论是通过你的学生代表、法律咨询还是了解这个流程的人。

sentences.en: And I think that in certain circumstances, my colleagues will agree with me here, the universities can be somewhat disingenuous by saying this is not adversarial.
sentences.zh: 我认为在某些情况下，我的同事们在这里会同意我的看法，大学有时会表现得有些虚伪，声称这不是对抗性的。

sentences.en: We're trying to help you.
sentences.zh: 我们在试图帮助你。

sentences.en: But the repercussions and the sanctions that they can impose are severe and can really affect your future ability to practice.
sentences.zh: 但他们可以施加的后果和制裁是严厉的，并且真的会影响你未来行医的能力。

sentences.en: So to try and exclude legal representation from the very stages of the process, which they actively do, they say, no, I don't think you should bring someone.
sentences.zh: 因此，试图从流程的最开始就排除法律代表——而他们确实正在积极地这样做——他们会说，不，我认为你不应该带任何人来。

sentences.en: Some laws actually say within the university you can't bring someone is problematic.
sentences.zh: 有些法律甚至规定，在大学里不能把某人带入有问题的情况。

sentences.en: And that's something I think the ACP should look into and various other organisations as well.
sentences.zh: 我认为ACP以及其他各种组织都应该关注这一点。

sentences.en: Yeah, thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你提供的信息。

sentences.en: I thought what we'd do is we'd go on to a little quickfire round.
sentences.zh: 我想我们接下来可以进行一个小型的快问快答环节。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 当然可以。

sentences.en: And we'll see how we get on with that.
sentences.zh: 我们看看这个环节进展如何。

sentences.en: OK, so with the fitness to practice for trainees, is it possible that it goes to stage one, you put some kind of procedures in place to change things,
sentences.zh: 好的，对于实习生的职业胜任能力，有没有可能进入第一阶段，你们采取某种程序来改变现状，

sentences.en: and then it never goes any further and it's just resolved and done?
sentences.zh: 然后事情就再也没有进一步发展，直接解决了就结束了？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全有可能。

sentences.en: And I'd argue that's the most common way that these things resolve themselves.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为这是此类问题最常见的解决方式。

sentences.en: So the stage one issues, maybe in terms of lateness, maybe in terms of social media, some slightly inappropriate communication, they resolve it.
sentences.zh: 所以第一阶段的问题，也许是关于迟到、社交媒体，或者一些稍微不当的沟通，他们会解决的。

sentences.en: You apologise, you write the appropriate letter, you show demonstrative learning and then it finishes.
sentences.zh: 你道个歉，写一封合适的信，表现出切实的学习成果，然后事情就结束了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，完全是这样。

sentences.en: That's the aim and the objective of the university at that stage.
sentences.zh: 这正是大学在该阶段的目标和宗旨。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Next question.
sentences.zh: 下一个问题。

sentences.en: With social media, is it true that even as pre-qualified staff, we need to be really careful about what we're putting out there into the world?
sentences.zh: 关于社交媒体，即使作为预注册员工，我们也真的需要对我们在网络上发布的内容格外小心，这是真的吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 千真万确。

sentences.en: I mean, I would argue that it's almost on a par because, and obviously with younger trainees,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这几乎同样重要，因为显然对于年轻的实习生来说，

sentences.en: they will be more versed in how this, in this world, it's literally part of society now, much more than when I was at university.
sentences.zh: 他们对这个世界的了解会更深，这在当今社会已经是生活的一部分了，比我上大学时要多得多。

sentences.en: But in terms of data protection, in terms of identification issues, well, obviously you won't necessarily,
sentences.zh: 但在数据保护方面，在身份识别问题方面，显然你不会非要，

sentences.en: hopefully you won't identify a client, your other colleagues, group photos, in terms of whether other people have agreed to be involved in this particular chat.
sentences.zh: 希望你不会透露客户、其他同事的身份、合影，以及其他人是否同意参与这个特定的聊天。

sentences.en: But, you know, being very wary also of your opinions, if you're going to be focal about a particular political opinion,
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，对于自己的观点也要非常警惕，如果你要对某个特定的政治观点发表强烈的看法，

sentences.en: whatever that may be, make sure that it's, first of all, adheres to the standards of your particular traineeship,
sentences.zh: 无论那是什么，首先要确保它符合你特定实习阶段的标准，

sentences.en: so whatever the NHS may be, whatever hospital you're working in, whatever you're doing, private practice, whatever it may be.
sentences.zh: 也就是无论国民保健署（NHS）规定如何，你在哪个医院工作，在做什么，私人诊所，无论是什么。

sentences.en: Yeah, just be very wary and just stay clear of, at this stage, on your public account, of making, you know,
sentences.zh: 是的，在这个阶段，在你的公开账号上，要非常警惕，避免发表，你知道的，

sentences.en: we don't want people to be robots, not have political opinions, but, yeah, just be careful.
sentences.zh: 我们不想让人们变成机器人，没有政治观点，但是，是的，小心谨慎一点。

sentences.en: Privacy, data protection, and also, yeah, some of the comments that, you know, you make.
sentences.zh: 隐私、数据保护，还有，是的，你发表的一些言论。

sentences.en: If someone picks it up, maybe it's someone else that you have a personal issue with, or someone,
sentences.zh: 如果有人注意到了，也许是你与之有个人矛盾的人，或者某个人，

sentences.en: it doesn't necessarily have to be your university that has actually picked up, hey, that comment was inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 不一定非要是你的大学发现“嘿，那个评论很不恰当”。

sentences.en: Maybe someone else you don't even know, they can raise that complaint to the university.
sentences.zh: 也许是一个你根本不认识的人，他们也可以向大学提出投诉。

sentences.en: So that applies to pre-registered, registered, it's really a, you know, a major source of FTP complaints for the HCPC and also for universities.
sentences.zh: 所以这适用于预注册人员、正式注册人员，这确实是英国健康与护理专业委员会（HCPC）和大学面临的重大职业胜任能力投诉来源。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Would it be enough to add to your social media bio, views are my own, not my employers?
sentences.zh: 在你的社交媒体个人简介里加上一句“观点仅代表个人，与雇主无关”，这样够吗？

sentences.en: Is that enough to cover a trainee or someone who's not yet qualified, or even someone who's qualified for that matter?
sentences.zh: 这足以涵盖实习生、尚未取得资格的人，甚至包括已经取得资格的人吗？

sentences.en: Is it enough?
sentences.zh: 这够吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不够。

sentences.en: Does it help?
sentences.zh: 有帮助吗？

sentences.en: Potentially, yes.
sentences.zh: 可能有吧。

sentences.en: I mean, it is a disclaimer that legally doesn't really count for anything.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，从法律上讲，这其实算不上什么免责声明。

sentences.en: Obviously, if your work, it depends on the type of work you're doing, but I think we all know the answer is essentially,
sentences.zh: 显然，如果你的工作，这取决于你从事的工作类型，但我认为我们都知道答案本质上是，

sentences.en: that's not going to prevent a complaint being made if what you're saying is completely unreasonable and irresponsible.
sentences.zh: 如果你说的话完全不合理且不负责任，这并不能阻止别人进行投诉。

sentences.en: So, no, within reason, if it's a nuanced idea about, say, for example, you may be critical of the NHS and how they're operating certain procedures,
sentences.zh: 所以，在合理范围内，如果这是一个细致入微的观点，比如说，你可能对NHS及其运作某些程序的方式持批评态度，

sentences.en: yeah, potentially that's not going to be a problem.
sentences.zh: 是的，潜在地这不会成为问题。

sentences.en: You're saying this is not what my employer says.
sentences.zh: 你在说这不是我雇主的意思。

sentences.en: But if it's a strong view, either way, political, social, then, yeah, that's not going to save you from any sort of FTP process.
sentences.zh: 但如果这是一个强烈的观点，无论是政治还是社会层面的，那么，是的，这无法让你免受任何职业胜任能力程序的处理。

sentences.en: I was raised in a way that kind of told me, never slate your employer on internal emails, never say that you wish you didn't work there,
sentences.zh: 我受到的教育方式让我养成了一种观念：永远不要在内部邮件中贬低你的雇主，永远不要说你希望自己没有在那里工作，

sentences.en: never criticise your employer publicly, because otherwise that can be used against you.
sentences.zh: 永远不要公开批评你的雇主，否则这些可能会被用来对付你。

sentences.en: And that's something I've definitely held on to.
sentences.zh: 这是我一直铭记在心的原则。

sentences.en: I mean, whether it's a wise career choice is a different issue, whether you're slagging off the head of the hospital.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是否是一个明智的职业选择是另一个问题，比如你是否在背后痛骂医院的负责人。

sentences.en: But they're two separate issues.
sentences.zh: 但这是两个独立的问题。

sentences.en: You may lose your job and you may be asked to find separate employment.
sentences.zh: 你可能会失业，也可能会被要求另谋高就。

sentences.en: But that's not necessarily going to be an FTP issue.
sentences.zh: 但这不一定会演变成职业胜任能力问题。

sentences.en: Does it go to your competency?
sentences.zh: 这关乎你的能力吗？

sentences.en: Does it go to your learning?
sentences.zh: 这关乎你的学习吗？

sentences.en: I'd argue not, depending, obviously, what they said.
sentences.zh: 我认为不会，当然这取决于他们说了什么。

sentences.en: But, yeah, you probably get sacked, but you won't have any problems with FTP.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，你可能会被解雇，但你不会在职业胜任能力方面遇到任何问题。

sentences.en: OK, thank you.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: Is it true that some universities have a very low tolerance for failed academic assignments and that even as few as two or three failed academic assignments can lead to fitness to practice that ultimately leads to you not finishing your course?
sentences.zh: 有些大学对不及格的学术作业容忍度极低，甚至只有两三门学术作业不及格就会引发职业胜任能力调查，并最终导致无法完成学业，这是真的吗？

sentences.en: I mean, in my experience, no, that's not necessarily the case.
sentences.zh: 以我的经验来看，不是的，情况不一定如此。

sentences.en: In my experience, the types of matters as they relate to clinical practice and proficiency will need to be broad, wide-ranging and serious.
sentences.zh: 根据我的经验，与临床实践和熟练程度相关的事项必须是广泛的、多方面的且严重的。

sentences.en: So, obviously, depending how important those particular academic tasks were, if they were your major component and you've tried it again and again and again and again.
sentences.zh: 所以，很明显，这取决于那些特定的学术任务有多重要，如果它们是你的主要部分，而你却一次又一次、一遍又一遍地尝试失败。

sentences.en: But, generally, the university FTP processes and then eventually the HCPC, they're not there to try and punish individual mistakes.
sentences.zh: 但总的来说，大学的职业胜任能力程序以及随后的HCPC，它们的存在并不是为了惩罚个人的失误。

sentences.en: That's really not the purpose of the whole process.
sentences.zh: 这绝不是整个流程的目的。

sentences.en: And I'd argue at university stage, it's absolutely not the purpose.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为在大学阶段，绝对不是这个目的。

sentences.en: So, I have no students who are now clients or trainees who are now clients where they've failed one or two things.
sentences.zh: 所以，我有一些现在成为客户的学生或实习生，他们曾经有一两门功课不及格。

sentences.en: It's generally a broad pattern of behaviour, serious misconduct, dishonesty, these types of matters, major communication issues.
sentences.zh: 这通常是一种广泛的行为模式、严重的不当行为、不诚实，以及诸如此类的事情，重大的沟通问题。

sentences.en: The ones that go to the end and you end up being excluded from the course, which is one of the options opening.
sentences.zh: 那些发展到最后导致你被开除出课程的情况，这是可能的处理选项之一。

sentences.en: And if you get excluded from a course, it's very difficult to find another placement in a different university.
sentences.zh: 如果你被一门课程开除，要在另一所大学找到另一个实习岗位是非常困难的。

sentences.en: It's not impossible.
sentences.zh: 并非不可能。

sentences.en: But, in my experience, it can lead to at least a very long gap in your ability to become a professional.
sentences.zh: 但在我的经验中，这至少会导致你的职业发展出现很长的空白期。

sentences.en: But, overall, it really is serious matters to do with dishonesty, repeated failings.
sentences.zh: 但总体而言，这确实是关于不诚实、重复失败等严重问题。

sentences.en: For example, note-taking, one example that I can think of is repeated issues in terms of not insufficient notes, but incomplete notes or no notes whatsoever.
sentences.zh: 例如，做记录，我能想到的一个例子是，在笔记方面出现重复的问题，不是笔记不充分，而是笔记不完整或者根本没有笔记。

sentences.en: So, for example, a student, a trainee, may have five or six clients, they're very hectic, they've got academic work going on, they've got work at home, they're stressed,
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，一个学生、实习生可能同时应付五六个客户，日程非常排满，既有学业要忙，还要处理家里的事情，压力很大，

sentences.en: they're not sleeping enough.
sentences.zh: 睡眠不足。

sentences.en: They meet a vulnerable teenager in this circumstances, they meet a vulnerable teenager,
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他们遇到了一位脆弱的青少年，他们遇到了一个脆弱的青少年，

sentences.en: but he says some very important information that needs to be passed on to the next psychologist who will see him, because it may not necessarily be that front-facing psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 但他说了非常重要的信息，这些信息需要转达给下一位接待他的心理学家，因为接诊的可能不一定是那个前台心理学家。

sentences.en: And there's no note, there's no note at all.
sentences.zh: 结果却没有记录，一点记录都没有。

sentences.en: And if this happened once, maybe that can be rectified.
sentences.zh: 如果这种情况发生了一次，也许还可以纠正。

sentences.en: If this happens again and again and again, this becomes a public safety issue.
sentences.zh: 如果这种情况一而再、再而三地发生，这就成了一个公共安全问题。

sentences.en: I think we can all understand that.
sentences.zh: 我想我们都能理解这一点。

sentences.en: Well, wait a second, this person was in a very vulnerable state, and that note could have potentially prevented a major catastrophe or, you know, endangered life.
sentences.zh: 等一下，这个人当时处于非常脆弱的状态，而那份笔记本来有可能防止一场重大灾难，或者你知道的，危及生命。

sentences.en: So, I do understand why they do this, but overall, two or three mistakes are not going to cost you your ability to be registered and shouldn't really lead you to the FTP track.
sentences.zh: 所以，我确实理解他们为什么要这样做，但总的来说，两三次失误不会剥夺你注册的资格，其实也不应该导致你走上职业胜任能力调查的轨道。

sentences.en: That'd be my answer to that.
sentences.zh: 这就是我对这个问题的回答。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So, with the rise of AI-supported note-taking, do you think that will lead to less fitness-to-practice issues,
sentences.zh: 那么，随着人工智能辅助记录的兴起，你认为这会减少职业胜任能力问题，

sentences.en: or do you think that could potentially cover up the disclosure of other fitness-to-practice issues?
sentences.zh: 还是认为这可能会掩盖其他职业胜任能力问题的暴露？

sentences.en: Yeah, very interesting question.
sentences.zh: 是的，这是一个非常有趣的问题。

sentences.en: And I envision that that's going to be an avalanche of future cases and how AI is managed within clinical settings is going to be something that is going to be a lot of my work and really lead to a lot of FTP cases.
sentences.zh: 我预见未来将会有海量的此类案件，如何在临床环境中管理人工智能将成为我大量工作的内容，并确实会导致大量的职业胜任能力案件。

sentences.en: At the moment, the issues that I can see in relation to AI and note-taking are really,
sentences.zh: 目前，我能看到的与人工智能和笔记相关的问题确实是，

sentences.en: if it's an accepted and recognised and safety-proof AI system that's being used and is being supported by whatever institution is and you're using it appropriately,
sentences.zh: 如果这是一个被接受、认可且经过安全性验证的人工智能系统，并且正在被任何机构使用，而你也在合规使用它，

sentences.en: then I think it's actually a real asset and a real help.
sentences.zh: 那么我认为这实际上是一项真正的资产和切实的帮助。

sentences.en: And what I can see is people who have time management issues and I have clients who wish, and they've said to me,
sentences.zh: 我看到的是那些有时间管理问题的人，我有一些客户曾希望，他们曾对我说过，

sentences.en: they wish these systems were in place before they had their problems because a lot of the issues related was purely time management.
sentences.zh: 他们希望在遇到问题之前这些系统就已经投入使用了，因为很多问题纯粹都与时间管理有关。

sentences.en: So, do I think there's going to be an improvement in terms of FTP issues?
sentences.zh: 所以，我认为在职业胜任能力问题上会有所改善吗？

sentences.en: I think it could work two ways.
sentences.zh: 我认为这可能会有两个方面的影响。

sentences.en: Some people, time management was the issue.
sentences.zh: 对于有些人来说，时间管理是个问题。

sentences.en: It's going to definitely help them.
sentences.zh: 这肯定会帮到他们。

sentences.en: They won't fall foul of the FTP matters.
sentences.zh: 他们不会陷入职业胜任能力的问题中。

sentences.en: In terms of AI generating false notes, I mean, how we actually, how we determine that, that could be some dishonesty issue.
sentences.zh: 至于人工智能生成虚假笔记，我的意思是，我们实际上如何确定这一点，这可能涉及某种不诚实的问题。

sentences.en: And if we find out retrospectively that these notes are actually not an accurate reflection of the meeting, then you go into dishonesty.
sentences.zh: 如果我们事后发现这些笔记实际上并没有准确反映会议情况，那么你就涉及不诚实了。

sentences.en: And any dishonesty across the board anywhere, and that's where I think AI can be a problem, as it may lead to some dishonest submissions,
sentences.zh: 任何地方的任何不诚实行为，这就是我认为人工智能可能成为问题的地方，因为它可能会导致一些不诚实的提交，

sentences.en: it may be some dishonest note-taking or some, then that becomes a problem.
sentences.zh: 可能是某些不诚实的笔记记录或其他情况，这就成了问题。

sentences.en: Dishonesty is frowned upon, as we understand, and the punishment is, yeah, severe sanctions in relation to dishonesty.
sentences.zh: 如我们所知，不诚实是不受欢迎的，其惩罚是，是的，针对不诚实行为会有严厉的制裁。

sentences.en: So, it's going to be somewhere, it's going to be a space we're definitely going to need to watch, both as clinicians and also as legal advisors.
sentences.zh: 所以，这将是一个我们作为临床医生和法律顾问绝对需要密切关注的领域。

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: We're not sure where it's going yet.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道它将走向何方。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Next question.
sentences.zh: 下一个问题。

sentences.en: Can a trainee refuse to engage in fitness to practice proceedings?
sentences.zh: 实习生可以拒绝参与职业胜任能力听证程序吗？

sentences.en: I mean, absolutely they can.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，当然可以。

sentences.en: Everyone has the right to do whatever they wish to do.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有权做自己想做的事。

sentences.en: That's also the case once registered.
sentences.zh: 注册后也是如此。

sentences.en: If you don't want to engage in any process, there's no legal obligation for you to do so outside of a criminal investigation.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想参与任何程序，除了刑事调查之外，你在法律上没有义务这样做。

sentences.en: However, if you do decide to remove yourself disengaged and not have any contact with the university and later on with the HCPC, it's really going to be frowned upon.
sentences.zh: 然而，如果你决定将自己抽离出来、不予配合，并且与大学以及后来的HCPC没有任何接触，这绝对会招致反感。

sentences.en: I mean, guess what that goes to is what we discussed earlier, this idea of insight.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可以猜到这回到了我们之前讨论的概念——洞察力。

sentences.en: So, if you don't think you did anything wrong, and it may be the case, and the facts may come to prove that later on, but you just say, look, this is unfair,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你认为自己没有做错任何事，事实也可能确实如此，事后事实证明了这一点，但你只是说，听着，这不公平，

sentences.en: I'm not engaging with it, I didn't do that.
sentences.zh: 我不参与这事，我没做过。

sentences.en: And the process starts, level one, tier one, however you want to view it, and then potentially you don't turn up, I don't want to go there, I don't agree,
sentences.zh: 然后流程开始了，一级，一阶，无论你怎么看，然后你可能不出现，我不想去那儿，我不同意，

sentences.en: you guys can all go do whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 你们爱怎么样就怎么样。

sentences.en: Then eventually, they're going to have a finding without you there, and then that can potentially lead to a full FDB investigation.
sentences.zh: 那么最终，他们会在你不在场的情况下做出裁决，这可能会导致全面的职业胜任能力调查。

sentences.en: If you still don't engage, as is your right, you are likely to be either suspended from the course, depending on the seriousness of the matters.
sentences.zh: 如果你仍然不配合，正如你有权做的那样，根据事情的严重程度，你很可能会被暂停学业。

sentences.en: But what I suggest to all clients, post-registration, pre-registration, actively engage.
sentences.zh: 但我对所有客户（无论是注册后还是注册前）的建议是：积极配合。

sentences.en: Actively engage.
sentences.zh: 积极配合。

sentences.en: That you can disagree, you can absolutely disagree, and that's where you have your viewpoint heard.
sentences.zh: 你可以不同意，你完全可以不同意，这正是你表达观点的地方。

sentences.en: But a lack of engagement shows a lack of respect to the university, to the institution, to clients, again, depending on the issue.
sentences.zh: 但缺乏配合表现出对大学、对机构、对客户的不尊重，当然这同样取决于具体问题。

sentences.en: But I think it's legally not a wise move, and I would not suggest you can disagree, get some support in how you respond.
sentences.zh: 但我认为从法律上讲这不是明智之举，我不建议你只说不同意，而是应该就如何回应寻求一些支持。

sentences.en: But if someone's raised a complaint, they need to have it heard properly.
sentences.zh: 但如果有人提出了投诉，就需要得到妥善的倾听和处理。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: This might well be the last of our quickfire round questions.
sentences.zh: 这很可能是我们快问快答环节的最后一个问题了。

sentences.en: But if someone is struggling personally, and they're recognising that because they've got some insight, is it better for them to just self-disclose that,
sentences.zh: 但如果有人在个人方面遇到困难，并且因为具备一些洞察力而意识到了这一点，他们是最好自己主动披露，

sentences.en: or to wait for proceedings to maybe be started against them by someone else?
sentences.zh: 还是等待别人对他们启动调查程序呢？

sentences.en: I mean, I think it's a common occurrence in relation to health.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这在健康问题上是很常见的现象。

sentences.en: And health can be in terms of how you're managing your caseload, how you're managing your studies.
sentences.zh: 这里的健康可以指你如何管理工作量，如何管理学习。

sentences.en: It doesn't have to be an actual physical ailment.
sentences.zh: 它不一定是指实际的身体疾病。

sentences.en: It can be anxiety, it can be sleep, it can be whatever's happening in your personal life.
sentences.zh: 它可以是焦虑，可以是睡眠，可以是个人生活中发生的任何事情。

sentences.en: If you feel like you can't meet the requirements of the course, which happens to many people across various sectors, across all sorts of higher level education,
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得自己无法满足课程的要求（这在各个行业、各种高等教育中很多人身上都会发生），

sentences.en: my advice would be really nip it in the bud early, get there early.
sentences.zh: 我的建议是：防患于未然，尽早处理。

sentences.en: And, you know, it doesn't necessarily have to be the instalment of reasonable adjustments, which is something universities can offer,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这不一定非得是实施合理调整（这是大学可以提供的服务），

sentences.en: which I actually not as difficult to have put in place as people may think.
sentences.zh: 而这种调整实际上并不像人们想象的那样难以落实。

sentences.en: So, you know, essentially reasonable adjustments are something that they're there to help university students.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，本质上合理调整的存在就是为了帮助大学生。

sentences.en: But if you are struggling psychologically, if you have, for example, an undisclosed or unknown mental health issue, or neurodivergence, or something else in your life,
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你在心理上苦苦挣扎，如果你例如有未披露或未知的心理健康问题、神经多样性问题，或者生活中的其他事情，

sentences.en: death of a family member, a lot of people say, well, that's my business, I don't want to get involved.
sentences.zh: 比如家人生病去世，很多人会说，这是我的私事，我不想让别人卷进来。

sentences.en: But if that's going to have a noticeable impact on your ability to complete the coursework, or particularly during the final stages of your placement, absolutely reach out.
sentences.zh: 但如果这会对你完成课程作业的能力产生明显影响，特别是在实习的最后阶段，一定要寻求帮助。

sentences.en: And that can be reaching out to various people within the university,
sentences.zh: 这可以通过联系大学里的各种人员来实现，

sentences.en: there's obviously there's a lot of support systems within that reaching out first and foremost to your supervisor, letting them know, can I take, you know, can I take,
sentences.zh: 显然，其中有很多支持系统，首先也是最重要的是联系你的主管，让他们知道，我能不能，你知道，我能不能，

sentences.en: can I get extra time off, there's a lot of things that can happen before it escalates.
sentences.zh: 我能不能请个长假，在情况升级之前有很多事情可以做。

sentences.en: Because once that escalation happens, and I've seen it, you know, particularly with burnout, mental health issues, once that once that we've reached that stage,
sentences.zh: 因为一旦升级发生，我见证过，特别是职业倦怠、心理健康问题，一旦我们到达那个阶段，

sentences.en: it becomes like a deck of cards, things start falling down very, very quickly.
sentences.zh: 事情就会像纸牌屋一样，非常非常快地崩塌。

sentences.en: And I've noticed something that hadn't been addressed very early in proceedings, in terms of, you know, an unmanaged health condition, had they reached out at that stage,
sentences.zh: 我注意到有些事情在诉讼初期没有得到妥善解决，比如未加控制的健康状况，如果他们在那个阶段寻求了帮助，

sentences.en: we could have potentially stopped everything that came, went henceforth, because actually all of this could have been done, could have been done appropriately with proper support.
sentences.zh: 我们本来有可能阻止之后发生的一切，因为实际上所有这些本来都可以做到，只要有适当的支持，本来就可以妥善完成。

sentences.en: And universities are essentially supportive places, supportive institutions, that's the experience I had, that's the experience most people have.
sentences.zh: 大学本质上是支持性的地方、支持性的机构，这是我的经历，也是大多数人的经历。

sentences.en: But if you don't tell people you're struggling, then it could look like that, actually, I'm just not up to scratch, actually, I don't care.
sentences.zh: 但如果你不告诉别人你在苦苦挣扎，那么情况看起来就会像是，实际上我就是不行，实际上我根本不在乎。

sentences.en: And, you know, I'd strongly advise, yeah, people to reach out as soon as it becomes, as soon as it has a visible effect on their work.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我强烈建议，是的，一旦它变成这样，一旦它对他们的工作产生了明显的影响，人们就要去寻求帮助。

sentences.en: You don't have to, if you're managing, fine.
sentences.zh: 你不需要非得这样，如果你能应付得来，那就好。

sentences.en: But as soon as it actually visibly affects your ability to practice or to complete work, then yeah, reach out immediately.
sentences.zh: 但一旦它确实明显影响了你实习或完成工作的能力，那么是的，立刻去寻求帮助。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think we can get in our own heads as well, can't we be thinking like, well, I started with my cohort,
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得我们也会自己胡思乱想，对吧？会想，嗯，我是和这批学员一起开始的，

sentences.en: I really want to graduate with them and be able to all celebrate together.
sentences.zh: 我真的很想和他们一起毕业，能一起庆祝。

sentences.en: But actually, we're all on our own journey.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，我们每个人都有自己的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you need to take some paid sick leave out from the course to really get yourself well, I would always advocate for that.
sentences.zh: 如果你需要从课程中请带薪病假来真正让自己康复，我一直都很赞成这样做。

sentences.en: Look after yourself first and know that actually, you know,
sentences.zh: 首先照顾好自己，并且要知道，实际上，你知道，

sentences.en: the people that you've started training with might still come and celebrate you outside your graduation ceremony on the day that you graduate.
sentences.zh: 和你一起开始培训的人，在你毕业当天可能仍然会来你的毕业典礼场外为你庆祝。

sentences.en: Because they're not going to forget that you exist, you're still part of that.
sentences.zh: 因为他们不会忘记你的存在，你仍然是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: And actually, you being happy, healthy, well, and thriving in your training is what everybody wants for you.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，你快乐、健康、状态良好并在培训中蓬勃发展，这才是所有人对你的期望。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: I mean, from my experience, everyone has their own path through studies, particularly in a stressful job like psychology.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，根据我的经验，每个人在学习过程中都有自己的道路，特别是在心理学这样压力很大的工作中。

sentences.en: You know, looking after yourself is fundamental, also for your ability to safely look after other people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，照顾好自己是根本，这也是你能够安全地照顾其他人的基础。

sentences.en: It's a different job.
sentences.zh: 这是一份不同的工作。

sentences.en: It's a different calling, if you want.
sentences.zh: 如果你愿意的话，这是一项不同的使命。

sentences.en: So, yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，完全同意。

sentences.en: People get there when they get there.
sentences.zh: 人们总会在该到达的时候到达。

sentences.en: And if your cohort doesn't want to support you, when you eventually get there, maybe they weren't really the people you wanted to hang out with anyway.
sentences.zh: 如果当你最终到达那里时，你的同学并不想支持你，也许他们本来就不是你想交往的人。

sentences.en: Such great advice, Nicholas.
sentences.zh: 多棒的建议啊，尼古拉斯。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, before we say goodbye, at least for now, can you let us know if someone is, you know,
sentences.zh: 那么，在我们道别之前，至少暂时道别，你能告诉我们，如果有人，你知道的，

sentences.en: at the beginning of this or kind of aware of someone else in their team who's going through this, what advice would you have for them?
sentences.zh: 刚开始经历这些，或者发现他们团队中有人正在经历这些，你有什么建议给他们？

sentences.en: Yeah, I guess it's a question I get asked retrospectively from trainees and also from employees.
sentences.zh: 对，我想这是学员和员工事后经常问我的一个问题。

sentences.en: What could we have done differently?
sentences.zh: 我们当时本来可以做哪些不同的事情？

sentences.en: I guess my answer would be when the concern is originally raised and you now have joined the process, so essentially you're now in the proceedings.
sentences.zh: 我想我的回答是，当最初提出担忧时，你现在已经加入了这个流程，所以本质上你现在正处于诉讼或听证程序中。

sentences.en: It might be an informal meeting, as we discussed, that informal meeting is informal, but, you know, you're essentially on the pathway towards a formal FTP hearing.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所讨论的，这可能是一个非正式会议，非正式会议虽然是非正式的，但你知道，你实际上已经踏上了通往正式不适宜执业（FTP）听证会的道路。

sentences.en: I would at the very least reach out to student services, student representatives, student bodies to say, hey, wait a second, is this something I need to treat seriously?
sentences.zh: 我至少会联系学生服务部门、学生代表、学生组织说，嘿，等一下，这是我需要认真对待的事情吗？

sentences.en: Because what I find with trainees and with students at the beginning and trainees at the end is that there's a complete lack of understanding of this FTP process.
sentences.zh: 因为我发现初期的学员以及快毕业的学员，对这个不适宜执业（FTP）流程完全缺乏理解。

sentences.en: And I understand it.
sentences.zh: 我能理解。

sentences.en: I understand that people have never encountered this before.
sentences.zh: 我理解人们以前从未遇到过这种情况。

sentences.en: It's an abstract concept.
sentences.zh: 这是一个抽象的概念。

sentences.en: Current impairment.
sentences.zh: 当前能力受损。

sentences.en: What does this actually mean?
sentences.zh: 这实际上意味着什么？

sentences.en: So you can have these sort of small complaint that had to do with an email you sent, what you wore, social media posts, some data protection,
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会有一些小投诉，比如关于你发送的一封电子邮件、你的着装、社交媒体帖子、一些数据保护问题，

sentences.en: an essay that you submitted that they have their doubts about.
sentences.zh: 或者你提交的一篇他们有疑问的论文。

sentences.en: And it may be quite minor.
sentences.zh: 这可能相当微不足道。

sentences.en: And maybe that first stage is just a very small stage.
sentences.zh: 也许第一阶段只是一个非常小的阶段。

sentences.en: But even if you think it's not that important, actually, there's nothing to it.
sentences.zh: 但即使你认为这没那么重要，实际上，这没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: I'd reach out to someone who has a bit more experience.
sentences.zh: 我还是会去联系一个更有经验的人。

sentences.en: Now, whether that's a practitioner or a legal advisor or someone within the university, at least particularly at that first stage,
sentences.zh: 无论是从业者、法律顾问还是大学内部的人，特别是在那个初期阶段，

sentences.en: so they can give you some perspective of what role we're in, how serious is this.
sentences.zh: 这样他们可以为你提供一些视角，让我们知道我们处在什么角色，这有多严重。

sentences.en: I'd definitely have a discussion with those that you're working with closely.
sentences.zh: 我绝对会与你密切合作的人进行一次讨论。

sentences.en: If you're at the end of your training, obviously, it depends who raised the complaint.
sentences.zh: 如果你正处于培训的尾声，显然这取决于谁提出了投诉。

sentences.en: But if your supervisor who's actively with you on a daily basis and it's unrelated to that supervisor, hey, having a chat to them if you're at that stage of the proceedings.
sentences.zh: 但如果每天和你在一起的主管（且投诉与该主管无关），嘿，如果你正处于程序的那个阶段，和他们聊聊是个办法。

sentences.en: And from that point onwards, if it does decide to go into a formal investigation, and or, for example, the student representative body or the student support service said, hey,
sentences.zh: 从那时起，如果决定进入正式调查，并且/或者例如学生代表组织或学生支持服务部门说，嘿，

sentences.en: this is pretty serious.
sentences.zh: 这相当严重。

sentences.en: I think you should get some advice before that first hearing, the tier one hearing, then reach out to them.
sentences.zh: 我认为在第一次听证会、一级听证会之前你应该寻求一些建议，那就去联系他们。

sentences.en: If you get told or you have the feeling that actually, wait a second, this has to do with dishonesty.
sentences.zh: 如果你被告知或有种感觉，实际上，等一下，这与不诚实有关。

sentences.en: This has to do with something that they're taking very seriously.
sentences.zh: 这与他们非常认真对待的事情有关。

sentences.en: And the fact that they've raised a complaint and they've called a hearing suggests that there's something to it.
sentences.zh: 他们提出投诉并召开听证会这一事实表明，此事并非空穴来风。

sentences.en: They're not just raising a complaint because you said the one inappropriate thing or you were late repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 他们不会仅仅因为你说了一句不恰当的话或屡次迟到就提出投诉。

sentences.en: That can be done informally.
sentences.zh: 那可以通过非正式方式处理。

sentences.en: That can be done with a chat.
sentences.zh: 那可以通过聊天来解决。

sentences.en: Hey, supervisor coming in, you're turning up late.
sentences.zh: 嘿，主管走过来，你上班迟到了。

sentences.en: You need to pick up your game.
sentences.zh: 你需要振作起来。

sentences.en: If it's reached that stage one, definitely reach out.
sentences.zh: 如果已经到了第一阶段，一定要去寻求帮助。

sentences.en: I have clients who reach out to me at stage one.
sentences.zh: 我有在第一阶段就联系我的客户。

sentences.en: So we're always open to that.
sentences.zh: 所以我们一直对此持开放态度。

sentences.en: But the student bodies are definitely worth discussing.
sentences.zh: 但学生组织绝对值得去沟通。

sentences.en: And once the decision has been made at stage one, that is a formal investigation, I'd absolutely seek out professional advice.
sentences.zh: 一旦在第一阶段做出了决定，那将是一项正式调查，我绝对会寻求专业建议。

sentences.en: Again, who that's with is entirely up to you.
sentences.zh: 同样，找谁完全取决于你。

sentences.en: But someone who has a rigorous understanding of the university guidelines and the fact that the FTP processes are different depending on which university you're in.
sentences.zh: 但要找一个对大学准则有透彻理解的人，并且要知道不适宜执业（FTP）流程会因你所在的大学不同而有所差异。

sentences.en: So, yeah, reach out, particularly post stage one.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，去寻求帮助，特别是在第一阶段之后。

sentences.en: But if you can make some inquiries in terms of pre-stage one, because once you're on that track, even if the university call it informal, there's notes from that.
sentences.zh: 但如果你能在第一阶段之前做一些咨询，因为一旦你走上这条轨道，即使大学称之为非正式的，也会有记录。

sentences.en: And there's eventually going to be leading you towards, hopefully not, but can potentially be leading you towards a full FTP university hearing.
sentences.zh: 并且最终可能会导致你走向全面大学不适宜执业（FTP）听证会，虽然希望不会，但确实有这种可能。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And with that in mind, could you please let our listeners and our viewers know where people can find out more about you and your work?
sentences.zh: 考虑到这一点，你能否让我们的听众和观众知道，人们在哪里可以找到更多关于你和你工作的信息？

sentences.en: Yeah, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: If people want to reach out, even for some informal advice or just to have a chat in relation to these issues or any other issues, I can be found on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 如果人们想要联系，哪怕只是为了征求一些非正式的建议，或者只是就这些问题或其他任何问题进行交流，都可以在领英（LinkedIn）上找到我。
