sentences.en: It's really probably the best place to find me and show some of the services they offer and some of the work that I do.
sentences.zh: 这很可能是找到我、了解我们所提供的部分服务以及我所做工作最好的地方。

sentences.en: And that's Nicholas Stockling, S-T-O-C-K-L-I-N-G.
sentences.zh: 我叫尼古拉斯·斯托克林，拼写是 S-T-O-C-K-L-I-N-G。

sentences.en: And you can find me on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 你可以在领英上找到我。

sentences.en: And I'll be more than happy to help.
sentences.zh: 我非常乐意提供帮助。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And I will link LinkedIn in the show notes and in the description with the video.
sentences.zh: 我会在节目笔记和视频描述中附上领英链接。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: And for the work that you do in supporting people in a really vulnerable time of their lives, Nicholas.
sentences.zh: 感谢你在人们生命中非常脆弱的时期为支持他们所做的工作，尼古拉斯。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: It's been a really interesting discussion.
sentences.zh: 这是一场非常有趣的讨论。

sentences.en: I think it's something that hopefully was helpful for various people at the various stages of their professional training.
sentences.zh: 我想这对于处于专业培训各个阶段的各种人来说，希望是有所帮助的。

sentences.en: Absolutely will be.
sentences.zh: 绝对会的。

sentences.en: Thank you again for your time.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: All the beSt.
sentences.zh: 祝一切顺利。

sentences.en: You too.
sentences.zh: 你也是。

sentences.en: Thank you so much again to my guest, Nicholas Stockling.
sentences.zh: 再次非常感谢我的嘉宾尼古拉斯·斯托克林。

sentences.en: Please do go and check him out on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 请务必去领英上关注他。

sentences.en: He really is a safe port in the storm if you are struggling with fitness to practice concerns.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在与不适宜执业（FTP）的问题作斗争，他真的是暴风雨中的避风港。

sentences.en: This was not my first chat with Nicholas.
sentences.zh: 这并不是我第一次和尼古拉斯聊天。

sentences.en: We did speak earlier more generically about fitness to practice for HCPC registered clinicians.
sentences.zh: 我们之前曾更广泛地探讨过针对HCPC注册临床医生的不适宜执业（FTP）问题。

sentences.en: And you can check those details out on screen.
sentences.zh: 你可以在屏幕上查看这些详细信息。

sentences.en: If you are an aspiring psychologist yourself, and even if you are a trainee psychologist, you might well find the aspiring psychologist membership helpful.
sentences.zh: 如果你自己是一个有志于成为心理学家的人，甚至如果你是一名心理学实习生，你很可能会发现“有志心理学家会员计划”对你有所帮助。

sentences.en: Some people do choose to stay in the membership during training because they really welcome that kind of personal approach, support and kind of compassion from their peers as well.
sentences.zh: 有些人确实选择在培训期间留在会员计划中，因为他们非常欢迎来自同伴的那种个人化方法、支持和同情。

sentences.en: We've also been trialing, doing some one-to-one time included in the membership at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 我们最近还在试行在会员计划中包含一些一对一的时间，不收取额外费用。

sentences.en: So please do keep your eyes peeled on the page www.aspiring-psychologiSt.co.uk for more information.
sentences.zh: 因此，请密切关注网址 www.aspiring-psychologist.co.uk 以获取更多信息。

sentences.en: Or if you've got any questions, you can reach out to me at any time or on social media where I'm Dr. Marianne Trent everywhere.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你有任何问题，可以随时联系我，或者在社交媒体上联系我，我在所有地方都是“玛丽安·特伦特博士（Dr. Marianne Trent）”。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能通过出售时间以外的方式赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，我自2019年以来一直在开发被动和经常性收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many program is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特（Sophie Foote）的一对多项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的奖励以及我自己的独家支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组智囊团、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特姆与梅森（Fortnum and Mason）礼品，以及限时一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
